clue.text: One who wrote lines about Greek island for 13 once

definitions.note: per the preamble, 13 stands for rugby league, a thirteen-a-side game; this club was renamed for a time

parts.note: Jack London, the American author of The Call of the Wild
BR is British Rail, a crossword stand-in for railway lines
on means about, as in a talk on a subject
Cos (Kos) is an island in the Dodecanese

explanation.surface: A poet who penned verses about a Greek island did so for some team of thirteen in the past.
explanation.walkthrough: The preamble's 'different rules' are the two rugby codes: league plays 13 a side, union 15. So '13' in a clue means a rugby league club, '15' a union one.
explanation.definitionFit: The Broncos are a rugby league club, playing the thirteen-a-side code, that traded under another name for some seasons.

clue.text: One getting to know English composer between hands

indicators.note: the composer and English sit between the two hands, which stand either side of them

parts.note: L and R are left and right hands
Thomas Arne, English composer of Rule, Britannia!

explanation.surface: Someone learning about an English composer, holding him between their hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A pupil or trainee is someone still acquiring knowledge of a skill.

clue.text: Almost slept through this rock piece?

indicators.note: almost tells us to stop one letter short of the full word for slept

parts.note: napped means slept briefly

explanation.surface: Someone nearly dozed off through this bit of music, whatever it was.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rock piece' suggests a rock song; it is geology.
explanation.definitionFit: In geology a nappe is a large sheet of rock pushed over neighbouring strata by folding or faulting.

clue.text: Shakespearean involved in catastrophe? Liar!

indicators.note: the name is wrapped up within the run of letters across these clue words

explanation.surface: Someone accuses a Shakespeare character of lying about being caught up in a disaster.
explanation.definitionFit: Ophelia is the tragic heroine of Hamlet, a character created by Shakespeare.

clue.text: Stays in Cornwall initially, heading away from a nearby county

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of Cornwall
the heading, or first letter, of the county is removed

parts.note: Dorset is a county near Cornwall in south-west England

explanation.surface: Someone stays in Cornwall at first, then leaves for the neighbouring county.
explanation.definitionFit: Stays were the boned undergarment women wore to shape the waist, the same garment as a corset.

clue.text: First bit of eroticism penned by absurdly horny writer

indicators.note: penned means enclosed, so the first piece sits inside the jumbled letters
absurdly signals the letters of horny are to be rearranged
the first bit of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A randy author writes a little erotic material.
explanation.walkthrough: 'penned by' puts E (start of eroticism) inside OHNRY, the anagram of HORNY signalled by 'absurdly'.
explanation.definitionFit: O. Henry was the pen name of the American short-story author William Sydney Porter.

clue.text: What's best off on the dairy counter?

definitions.text: What's best off on the dairy counter?

parts.note: milk that is off has gone sour
the cream is the best part of anything

explanation.surface: A question about which product is best taken off the dairy shelf.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'best off' as 'best gone bad': cream that is off is sour.
explanation.definitionFit: Soured cream is a dairy product deliberately made by souring ordinary cream.

clue.text: Occupation of the vacant girl

indicators.note: a vacant word is emptied of its middle, leaving only its outside letters

parts.note: Nancy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl with nothing in her head has a job.
explanation.definitionFit: Occupation of a house means living in it as a tenant, which is what a tenancy is.

clue.text: Drama ham sent off new play

indicators.note: sent off is wrong; off shows the letters are out of place and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A hammy actor is sent off a new play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent off' looks like the phrase; 'sent' is fodder and 'off' alone is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Arms and the Man is a comedy for the stage by George Bernard Shaw.

clue.text: Lived quietly as one of 15 or one of the 18?

definitions.text: one of 15 or one of the 18?
definitions.note: a rugby union player for the Wasps club, or a stinging insect like those at 18

parts.note: was means lived, existed
p (piano) means quietly in music

explanation.surface: Someone lived quietly as a rugby player.
explanation.walkthrough: Wasps is a rugby union club (15 a side); 18 is the light holding the second word of 21, insects akin to wasps.
explanation.definitionFit: A player of the Wasps union club is a wasp, and the insect is a cousin of the stinging hornet.

clue.text: 15 hospital somewhere in southern France holds one of 5

definitions.note: per the preamble, 15 is rugby union

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: the town holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: Arles is a town in Provence
a quin is one of quintuplets, five born together

explanation.surface: A rugby team's hospital in a Provençal town treats a quintuplet.
explanation.definitionFit: Harlequins is a London rugby union club, playing the fifteen-a-side code.

clue.text: Queen with quite short temper

parts.note: Queen Anne, British monarch 1702-1714

indicators.note: short means cut off the last letter

parts.note: all means quite, completely, as in all alone

explanation.surface: A queen with a rather quick temper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'temper' looks like a mood; it is the metalworking verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To temper metal or glass is to heat and cool it to toughen it, which is the meaning of anneal.

clue.text: 15 people admitted to hospitals shortly?

definitions.note: per the preamble, 15 is rugby union

indicators.note: the people are taken inside, as a patient is admitted

parts.note: san is short for sanatorium, so the plural shortened is sans
a race is a people

explanation.surface: A rugby team's players taken into hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark notes that Saracens were also a people, the Muslims of the Crusades.
explanation.definitionFit: Saracens is a north London rugby union club, playing the fifteen-a-side code.

clue.text: Relative by blood loses nothing by a jibe

indicators.note: loses means a letter is taken out of the word for blood

parts.note: gore is spilt blood
O looks like zero, nothing
a taunt is a jibe

explanation.surface: A blood relative loses out because of a cutting remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's aunt is a relation two generations up in the family tree.

clue.text: One party intended verbal shaming

parts.note: a means one
a bash is a party

indicators.note: verbal means spoken, so the word sounds like intended said out loud

parts.note: meant means intended

explanation.surface: One partygoer intended to humiliate someone with words.
explanation.definitionFit: Abashment is embarrassment or shame, the state of being made to feel ashamed.

clue.text: Hot times in Surrey after leaving the city, right?

indicators.note: the times sign goes inside what remains of the county
the city and right are taken out of Surrey

parts.note: Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia
x is the multiplication sign for times

explanation.surface: A hot spell in Surrey once you have left the city, right?
explanation.walkthrough: 'after leaving' strips the ancient city and right out of the county name; 'in' then puts the times sign into what is left. 'Hot' looks like weather but means attractive.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot in slang means sexually attractive.

clue.text: Give birth to one of 13 in Bradford? No, opposite in the marketplace

definitions.meaning: to ... a child is to give birth to it

definitions.text: one of 13 in Bradford? No, opposite in the marketplace
definitions.meaning: the Bradford rugby league side are the Bulls; the market opposite of a bull is a speculator betting on falling prices

explanation.surface: A rugby player in Bradford gives birth, or rather the opposite in the market.
explanation.walkthrough: Bradford Bulls are a rugby league club. On the stock market a bull expects rises, its opposite expects falls.
explanation.definitionFit: A stock-market speculator who sells expecting prices to fall is the opposite of a bull.

clue.text: See 1 across
Some that lost time with no more allowed

indicators.note: lost suggests the letters have gone astray and must be put back in a new order

explanation.surface: Some people who wasted time were not allowed any more.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means as an upper limit, no more than, which is what with no more allowed says.

clue.text: See 21
McCartney runs like a celebrity?

parts.note: Stella McCartney, the fashion designer
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: Does McCartney run like a famous person?
explanation.definitionFit: Stellar describes a star, and a celebrity is a star of stage or screen.

clue.text: Man stealing Ford from 13

indicators.note: stealing takes the word Ford away from the club name

parts.note: Castleford Tigers are a Yorkshire rugby league club, rugby league being 13 per the preamble
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man steals a Ford car from a rugby league team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ford' looks like the car; it is just the last four letters of the club.
explanation.definitionFit: In chess the pieces are called men, and the rook is also known as a castle.

clue.text: Playing Handel, orchestra ring for a 13

definitions.note: per the preamble, 13 is rugby league

indicators.note: playing music suggests the letters are performed in a new arrangement
the ring stands in place of an A in orchestra

parts.note: O is ring-shaped

explanation.surface: An orchestra playing Handel rings up a rugby league team.
explanation.walkthrough: First turn an A in ORCHESTRA into O ('ring for a'), then 'Playing' rearranges it with HANDEL.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hornets are a Lancashire rugby league club, playing the thirteen-a-side code.

clue.text: Make fun of bottom that's bony?

parts.note: to rib someone is to tease them
a bed is the bottom of a river or sea

explanation.surface: Is it unkind to tease a skinny bottom?
explanation.definitionFit: Ribbed means having ribs showing, ridged like a bony frame.

clue.text: Most Moses baskets originally revolved around a bunch of twigs

indicators.note: originally picks out the opening letter of baskets
revolved around means turned to face the other way, so the letters are read backwards
most of the name means dropping its last letter

explanation.surface: Moses baskets mostly began by spinning round a bundle of twigs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolved around' turns MOSE (most of Moses) into ESOM after B.
explanation.definitionFit: A besom is a broom made of a bundle of twigs tied round a handle.

clue.text: Worried about acne? Cut out stress

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the anagram goes inside

parts.note: ate means worried, as in what's eating you

indicators.note: out means awry, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Anxious about acne? Stop stressing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cut out' reads as one phrase, but only 'out' is the anagram signal; 'Worried' is not an anagram signal either but the synonym that 'about' wraps round the jumble.
explanation.definitionFit: To accentuate is to emphasise, to lay stress upon.

clue.text: 15 witches hunted here, briefly

definitions.note: per the preamble, 15 is rugby union

indicators.note: briefly means cut short by the last letter

parts.note: Salem, Massachusetts, scene of the 1692 witch trials

explanation.surface: A rugby union club where witches were hunted, in brief.
explanation.definitionFit: Sale Sharks are a rugby union club from Greater Manchester, playing the fifteen-a-side code.

clue.text: I have hidden Titania's crown amongst enchanted trees …

indicators.note: amongst puts the crown inside the rearranged trees
enchanted trees are bewitched, turned into something else
the crown is the top, the first letter

explanation.surface: Someone has hidden the fairy queen's crown in a magic wood.
explanation.walkthrough: From the setter's view, 'I' is the setter. Titania is fairy queen in A Midsummer Night's Dream.
explanation.definitionFit: In a crossword, the person speaking as I is the compiler who set the puzzle.

clue.text: … putting love into one enterprise with right chemical substance

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: putting into means inserting the love inside the enterprise

parts.note: SME is a small or medium-sized enterprise
O is love, a zero score in tennis

explanation.surface: Investing love in a business with the right chemistry.
explanation.definitionFit: An isomer is a compound with the same atoms as another but arranged differently.
